title: Docker broker protocol 26
$comment: Changes to the protocol format defined by this schema require bumping Version in src/broker/internal/protocol/protocol.go.

repo.$comment: A repo grant: its token reaches this repository alone; absent: every repository of every installation.

github_repo.$comment: A github.com repository, owner/name; GitHub forbids the names . and ..

credentials.$comment: Opaque JSON text, preserved byte-for-byte after decoding the outer JSON string. Only the broker decodes and validates contentSchema; session and delegate do neither.

secrets.$comment: Environment secrets by keychain reference; the broker also refuses a file repeated in the list and a file over 255 bytes.

gateway.$comment: The egress proxy's caller network key (windroc.egress.networks); absent: workers.

prefetch.$comment: The repo a start clones into a workspace volume it creates; no ref: the default branch.
A prefetching container gets no GitHub token (github null) or a repo grant's, which reaches one repository.

argv.$comment: Then an optional --base-image IMAGE, then any --plugin SOURCE pairs, then any --image-plugin NAME pairs, then an optional --max-age SECONDS; JSON Schema cannot pair repeated tokens, so the broker checks the order (usage).

base_image.$comment: A local image the broker layers ensemble on, never pulling it: a tag, repository[:tag] or sha256 ID; no registry port or digest.

plugin_name.$comment: An in-image plugin: its directory under /opt/windroc/plugins in the stage-1 image.

git_ref.$comment: A branch or tag name, ensemble.utils.git.check_ref's rule (WDRC-109 FR-52).

credential_spec.$comment: Broker-only contract: independently validate both declarations, then replace whole same-kind environment values with the caller value. No secret values. The broker validates all kinds and currently serves only linear through its credential delivery batch; request github/env serving follows separately.
